description: Three-resource, three-sender protocol formation with compositional message slots
research_question: Does a grounded protocol still form when three independently observed resources must be combined into one receiver action, and does partner-topology coverage affect slot-wise compositionality?

training_topologies.rotating_AB: A on even updates and B on odd updates
training_topologies.random_ABC: A, B or C sampled from a deterministic per-update schedule

population.private_visual_encoders: frozen encoders inherited from two-resource perceptual training
population.communication_initialization: fresh random sender and receiver heads

limits: The three resource visual frontends are inherited and frozen; only communication heads are newly initialized.
A three-token tuple tests slot-wise grounded composition, not open-ended grammar or natural language.
The reward is shared and the joint policy-gradient update is centralized.
Four agents, six sites and experimenter-defined topology schedules are a controlled mechanism probe.
